 Follow Are banks closed on Election Day 2026? Here’s what to know
 Katherine Rodriguez Wed, October 28, 2026 at 9:01 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Election Day 2026 is coming up soon, and that means many people will be heading to the polls to vote.
 While it is not a federal holiday, it is only a holiday in certain states — and some services remain closed on the day.
 However, if you wish to conduct banking transactions, you're in luck — most banks should be open and ready to serve you because it is not one of the listed Federal Reserve holidays .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Branches should open according to their regular hours and other banking services such as ATMs and online transactions should be available.
 Here is what to know about banking hours on Election Day 2026.
